a1_branchfiber.ef: executes the path that joins the failing child; the other branch leaves it unobserved, so the refusal is correct (design 5.3 rule 2)
d6_armjoin.ef: joined in one arm only; the executed path takes the join arm. Refused since b29ddf3 by design
m1_recursion.ef: rec(2) may raise Boom before the join; an exit before the join leaves the child pending, as at statement level
m2_recursion_nojoin.ef: child never observed; executes one recursion path
rv-fork-unjoined-failure.ef: unjoined failing child; Go executes it before the child fails (race), JS raises it. Witness: rv-fork-unjoined-failure-sleep
